notes: Direct native HTTP only; no Worker, R2 or result-cache requests.
Raw hot and typed-ID routes must return identical expected ResolutionV1 bytes, source identities, signature counts and actual previous hash.

Every reply is SHA checked, framing/locator/access-prefix parsed, and required to report BYPASS plus positive table preads. Full independent dictionary parsing can run on Mac against exported validation bodies.

HTTP clocks stop at EOF. Client hashing, parsing and equality checks occur after timing. Input files are loaded one fixture at a time before timing. Request/reply byte counts are HTTP entity bytes, excluding headers/TLS.
CPU-Micros explicitly measures native synchronous blocking CPU; other Micros headers are elapsed time. HTTP/auth/runtime work outside that scope is not total server CPU.
Warmup and timed requests are separate. Repeated preads can use the OS page cache; they do not prove physical disk reads.
Only two reply buffers are held for each equality check. Optional saved bodies are finite validation evidence, not a serving index or cache.
URL, token, locator header and body mappings are excluded from this JSON report. No redirect is followed and no failed request is retried.
